title: Arsenal and Newcastle: Raya's injury scare, Madueke's rescue and a seesaw draw
body:
Arsenal left St James' Park with a point and a worry after a seesaw draw at Newcastle [S1]. Raya was injured, but Madueke rescued a result from the mess [S1]. A point on the road is useful, but it came with a scare nobody wanted.

Eddie Howe is no longer in the Newcastle dugout, and Matthias Jaissle has taken over [S1]. Arteta was glad to see Howe go, but the new coach has shown he is no pushover [S1]. Newcastle were overwhelmed early, then came back with a stellar second half after a triple substitution and a tactical rejig [S1]. Sky Sports put the Arsenal side of the story down to complacency, calling their second-half drop-off extraordinary [S2].

The form guide tells a similar story. Arsenal have won their last five league matches, scoring seven and conceding one [ST1]. Newcastle have managed one win, one draw and three defeats in their last five, scoring four and conceding seven [ST2]. Those numbers make a draw in this fixture look like a slip rather than a shock, and the second half is where the damage was done.

Nobody wins anything in the treatment room, but plenty of seasons are lost there. This is where squad depth gets tested, and that is where seasons are quietly decided.

The Touchline Take: how the squad copes with this injury will define the next month.

evidence.text: The Guardian: Raya injured but Madueke rescues point for Arsenal in seesaw Newcastle draw. If Mikel Arteta was delighted to see the back of Eddie Howe as Newcastle’s head coach, the bad news is that another similarly awkward technical area adversary has been installed at St James’ Park. Arsenal’s manager never seemed to relish trips to face Howe’s old team and he certainly did not enjoy this latest trip to Tyneside, where Matthias Jaissle’s initially overwhelmed team fought back commendably to earn a point courtesy of a stellar second-half performance. At half-time the crowd had felt close to turning against Jaissle but he held his nerve and, thanks to a triple substitution and subtle tactical rejig suggested he is no mug after all.
